en.s: Pope Leo III (Latin: Leo III; died 12 June 816) was bishop of Rome and leader of the Papal States from 26 December 795 to his death on 12 June 816. Protected by Charlemagne from the supporters of his predecessor, Adrian I, Leo subsequently strengthened Charlemagne's position by crowning him emperor. The coronation was not approved by most people in Constantinople, although the Byzantines, occupied with their own defenses, were in no position to offer much opposition.

zh.s: 795年12月26日，利奥三世当选教宗，接替阿德里安一世。他在查理曼保护下摆脱前任支持者的威胁，后来为查理曼加冕为皇帝，巩固了查理曼的地位。

en.t: Berengar I is elected as king of Italy by the lords of Lombardy. He is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy at Pavia
en.s: Lombardy (Lombard and Italian: Lombardia; Romansh: Lumbardia) is an administrative region of Italy that covers 23,844 km2 (9,206 sq mi); it is located in northern Italy and with a population of about 10 million is the most populous region, constituting more than one-sixth of Italy's population.

zh.t: 贝伦加尔一世经伦巴第诸侯推举为意大利国王，并在帕维亚加冕为伦巴第铁王冠
zh.s: 伦巴第（伦巴第语和意大利语：Lombardia；罗曼什语：Lumbardia）是意大利北部的一个行政区，面积23,844平方公里，人口约1000万，是意大利人口最多的地区，占全国人口六分之一以上。

en.s: The Battle of Westbroek was a battle that occurred on December 26, 1481 between the armies of the prince-bishopric of Utrecht and the county of Holland. It was one of the last battles of the Hook and Cod wars. That war had already been decided in Holland in favour of the Cods and their Burgundian allies. But in Utrecht, they had lost the power, when Bishop David of Burgundy, who had ruled Utrecht since 1456, was chased there after the outbreak of the Second Utrecht Civil War. On December 26, 1481, David sent an army of 4-5000 men from Holland in the direction of Utrecht.

zh.s: 1481年12月26日，乌得勒支采邑主教国与荷兰伯国的军队在韦斯特布鲁克交战，这是钩党与鳕党战争的最后几场战斗之一。伯艮第主教大卫当时流亡在荷兰，12月26日他派出4,000至5,000人的军队向乌得勒支进军。

en.s: The Expedition to Vyborg was a major military campaign undertaken by the Russians in winter of 1556. The main goal of the expedition was to inflict as much material and human damage on Swedish forces as possible, which would compel Stockholm to request a truce. A new Russo-Swedish war started over border disputes began in 1554. Already in early 1555, the Russians were defeated at the fortress of Kivinebb by local militias.

zh.s: 1555年12月26日，俄军从诺夫哥罗德出发，开始向维堡方向远征。俄军直到次年1月20日才越过瑞典边境。远征的目标是尽可能削弱瑞典军队，迫使斯德哥尔摩请求停战。

en.s: The Second Battle of Middlewich took place on 26 December 1643 near Middlewich in Cheshire during the First English Civil War. A Royalist force under Lord Byron defeated a Parliamentarian army commanded by Sir William Brereton.

en.t: The opera Agrippina, described as George Frideric Handel's first masterpiece, premiered in Venice
en.s: Agrippina (HWV 6) is an opera seria in three acts by George Frideric Handel with a libretto by Cardinal Vincenzo Grimani. Composed for the 1709–10 Venice Carnevale season, the opera tells the story of Agrippina, the mother of Nero, as she plots the downfall of the Roman emperor Claudius and the installation of her son as emperor.

en.t: Bach led the first performance of Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn Gottes, BWV 40, his first Christmas Cantata composed for Leipzig
en.s: Darzu ist erschienen der Sohn Gottes (For this the Son of God appeared), BWV 40, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in 1723, his first year in Leipzig, for the Second Day of Christmas, and first performed it on 26 December that year in both main churches, Thomaskirche and Nikolaikirche. It was the first Christmas cantata Bach composed for Leipzig.

zh.t: 巴赫首次演出清唱剧《上帝之子显现》
zh.s: 1723年12月26日，约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫在莱比锡两座主要教堂首次演出清唱剧《上帝之子显现》（BWV 40）。这是他为莱比锡创作的第一部圣诞清唱剧。

en.s: The Battle of Trenton was a small but pivotal battle during the American Revolutionary War which took place on the morning of December 26, 1776, in Trenton, New Jersey. After General George Washington's crossing of the Delaware River north of Trenton the previous night, Washington led the main body of the Continental Army against Hessian soldiers garrisoned at Trenton. After a brief battle, nearly the entire Hessian force was captured, with negligible losses to the Americans. The battle significantly boosted the Continental Army's flagging morale, and inspired re-enlistments. The Continental Army had previously suffered several defeats in New York and had been forced to retreat through New Jersey to Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 1776年12月26日上午，乔治·华盛顿率大陆军在新泽西州特伦顿突袭黑森驻军。美军前一晚刚渡过特拉华河，战斗后几乎俘虏了整支黑森部队，自身损失很小。这场胜利提振了大陆军士气，也鼓舞士兵续签服役。

en.s: The Second Battle of Wissembourg from 26 December 1793 to 29 December 1793 saw an army of the First French Republic under General Lazare Hoche fight a series of clashes against an army of Austrians, Prussians, Bavarians, and Hessians led by two generals, namely, the Austrian Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser and the Prussian Charles William Ferdinand, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel. There were significant actions at Wœrth on 22 December and Geisberg on 26 and 27 December. In the end, the French forced their opponents to withdraw to the east bank of the Rhine River.

zh.s: 1793年12月26日至29日，拉扎尔·奥什将军率领的法兰西第一共和国军队与奥地利、普鲁士、巴伐利亚和黑森联军交战。12月26日至27日，盖斯贝格发生激战；最终法军迫使联军退至莱茵河东岸。

en.s: The Battle of Pozzolo also known as the Battle of the Mincio River and Monzambano (25–26 December 1800) was fought during the War of the Second Coalition. A French army under General Guillaume Brune crossed the Mincio River and defeated an Austrian force under General Heinrich von Bellegarde. The Austrians were subsequently pushed back to Treviso where the Armistice of Treviso was signed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1800年12月25日至26日，第二次反法同盟战争期间，纪尧姆·布吕纳将军率法军渡过明乔河，击败海因里希·冯·贝勒加德将军率领的奥军。奥军随后退至特雷维索，并在那里签署停战协定。

en.t: Austria and France sign the Treaty of Pressburg
en.s: The Peace of Pressburg was signed in Pressburg (today Bratislava) on 26 December 1805 between French Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte and Holy Roman Emperor Francis II, as a consequence of the French victory over the Russians and Austrians at the Battle of Austerlitz (2 December). A truce was agreed on 4 December, and negotiations for the treaty began.

zh.t: 奥地利与法国签署《普雷斯堡和约》
zh.s: 1805年12月26日，法国皇帝拿破仑·波拿巴与神圣罗马帝国皇帝弗朗茨二世在普雷斯堡（今布拉迪斯拉发）签署《普雷斯堡和约》。此前，法国在奥斯特里茨战役中击败俄奥联军，双方于12月4日达成停战，随后开始谈判。

en.s: The Battle of Pułtusk took place on 26 December 1806 during the War of the Fourth Coalition near Pułtusk, Poland. Approximately 40,000 Russian soldiers with 128 guns under General Levin August, Count von Bennigsen resisted the attacks of 25,000 First French Empire soldiers under Marshal Jean Lannes. Although the attacks were repulsed and the French were driven back to their positions, the Russians safely withdrew the day after this Napoleonic Wars action to prevent being surrounded by the entire French army, which is why some historians view the battle as indecisive.

zh.s: 1806年12月26日，第四次反法同盟战争期间，列文·奥古斯特·冯·贝尼格森伯爵率约4万名俄军和128门火炮，在波兰普乌图斯克抵御让·拉纳元帅率领的2.5万名法军。俄军击退法军进攻，法军退回原阵地；为避免被法国主力包围，俄军次日安全撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Golymin took place on 26 December 1806 during the Napoleonic Wars at Gołymin, Poland, between around 17,000 Russian soldiers with 28 guns under Prince Golitsyn and 38,000 French soldiers under Marshal Murat. The Russian forces disengaged successfully from the superior French forces. The battle took place on the same day as the Battle of Pułtusk.

zh.s: 1806年12月26日，拿破仑战争期间，约1.7万名俄军与3.8万名法军在波兰戈利明交战。俄军在戈利岑亲王指挥下成功脱离战斗，摆脱兵力占优的法军。普乌图斯克战役也在同一天发生。

en.s: The Siege of Belgrade (Serbian: Опсада Београда, romanized: Opsada Beograda), known as the Liberation of Belgrade (Ослобођење Београда, Oslobođenje Beograda) was carried out by the Serbian rebels led by Karađorđe, seeking to overthrow the Ottoman government in the Sanjak of Smederevo, which was seated in the Belgrade Fortress. Following the victories at Mišar (13–15 August) and Deligrad (3 September), the Serbian rebels marched towards Belgrade.

zh.s: 到1806年12月26日，塞尔维亚起义军已控制贝尔格莱德，结束了奥斯曼对这座城市的统治。起义军由卡拉乔尔杰率领，目标是推翻塞梅德雷沃桑贾克的奥斯曼政权。

en.s: The Richmond Theatre fire occurred in Richmond, Virginia, United States, on Thursday, December 26, 1811. It devastated the Richmond Theatre, located on the north side of Broad Street between what is now Twelfth and College Streets. The fire killed 72 people, including Virginia's governor George William Smith, former U.S. senator Abraham B. Venable, and other government officials in what was the worst urban disaster in U.S. history at the time. The Monumental Church was erected on the site as a memorial to the fire.

zh.s: 1811年12月26日，美国弗吉尼亚州里士满剧院发生大火，剧院被烧毁，72人遇难，其中包括州长乔治·威廉·史密斯和前联邦参议员亚伯拉罕·B·维纳布尔。后来，人们在原址修建纪念教堂。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool Town Council were held on Saturday 26 December 1835. This was the first election to Liverpool Town Council. It was conducted under the provisions of the Municipal Corporations Act 1835. As this was the first election to the Council, all three seats for each of the sixteen wards were up for election. The candidate in each ward with the highest number of votes was elected for three years, the candidate with the second highest number of votes was elected for two years and the candidate with the third highest number of votes was elected for one year.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1835年12月26日星期六举行，是利物浦市议会的首次选举，依据《1835年市政公司法》进行。由于这是首次选举，16个选区各有3个席位改选。每个选区得票最高的候选人当选三年，第二名当选两年，第三名当选一年。

en.s: The Battle of San Joaquín took place on December 26, 1858 in the municipality of Cuauhtémoc in the state of Colima, Mexico, between elements of the liberal army, under General Santos Degollado and elements of the preservative army commanded by General Miguel Miramon during the War of Reform.

zh.s: 1858年12月26日，改革战争期间，桑托斯·德戈亚多将军率自由派军队与米格尔·米拉蒙将军率保守派军队在墨西哥科利马州夸乌特莫克交战。

en.s: The Battle of Chustenahlah was fought in Osage County, Oklahoma, (then Indian Territory) on December 26, 1861, during the American Civil War. A band of 9,000 pro-Union Native Americans was forced to flee to Kansas in bitter cold and snow in what became known as the Trail of Blood on Ice.

zh.s: 1861年12月26日，美国内战期间，支持联邦的约9,000名原住民在俄克拉何马州奥塞奇县战败，被迫冒着严寒和风雪逃往堪萨斯。这段撤逃后来被称为“冰雪上的血路”。

en.s: The Battle of Chickasaw Bayou, also called the Battle of Walnut Hills, fought December 26–29, 1862, was the opening engagement of the Vicksburg Campaign during the American Civil War. Confederate forces under Lt. Gen. John C. Pemberton repulsed an advance by Union Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman that was intended to lead to the capture of Vicksburg, Mississippi. On December 26, three Union divisions under Sherman disembarked at Johnson's Plantation on the Yazoo River to approach the Vicksburg defenses from the northeast while a fourth landed farther upstream on December 27.

zh.s: 1862年12月26日，威廉·谢尔曼率领的3个联邦军师在亚祖河约翰逊种植园登陆，准备从东北方向进攻维克斯堡防线。另一支联邦军部队于次日更上游登陆。南方邦联军随后击退了谢尔曼的进攻。

en.s: Following the Dakota War of 1862, the U.S. government executed 38 Dakota men in Mankato, Minnesota, on December 26, 1862, in the largest mass execution in American history. In the course of the conflict, 358 American settlers, 77 soldiers, and 36 militia had been killed. A military commission assembled in the aftermath carried out rushed trials of the Dakota men, some lasting only minutes, and ultimately sentencing 307 to death.

zh.s: 1862年12月26日，美国政府在明尼苏达州曼卡托处决38名达科他族男子。这是美国历史上规模最大的一次集体处决。达科他战争期间，358名美国定居者、77名士兵和36名民兵遇害。

en.s: The siege of Peronne was a battle during the Franco-Prussian War, from December 26, 1870 until January 9, 1871, in Péronne, Somme of France. The German siege force, under the command of Lieutenant Generals August von Goeben and Albert von Barnekow, forced the French army at Péronne- which could not be rescued and had to surrender after more than a week under the bombardment of the Prussian army.

zh.s: 1870年12月26日至1871年1月9日，普法战争期间，德国军队围攻法国索姆省的佩罗讷。法军无法获得救援，在遭受一周多炮击后被迫投降。

en.t: Thespis, the first comic opera by Gilbert and Sullivan, premiered at the Gaiety Theatre in London
en.s: Thespis, or The Gods Grown Old, is an operatic extravaganza that was the first collaboration between dramatist W. S. Gilbert and composer Arthur Sullivan. No musical score of Thespis was ever published, and most of the music has been lost. Gilbert and Sullivan went on to become the most famous and successful artistic partnership in Victorian England, creating a string of enduring comic opera hits, including H.M.S.

zh.t: 吉尔伯特与沙利文首部喜歌剧《忒斯庇斯》在伦敦首演
zh.s: 《忒斯庇斯》又名《众神老去》，是歌剧式娱乐作品，也是剧作家W. S. 吉尔伯特与作曲家亚瑟·沙利文的首次合作。该剧从未出版乐谱，大部分音乐已经失传。此后，吉尔伯特与沙利文成为维多利亚时代英格兰最著名、最成功的艺术搭档，创作了一系列经久不衰的喜歌剧，包括《H.M.S. 品娜福号》《彭赞斯海盗》和《日本天皇》。

en.t: Marie and Pierre Curie announce the isolation of radium
en.s: Pierre Curie (15 May 1859 – 19 April 1906) was a French physicist and chemist, and a pioneer in crystallography and magnetism. He shared one half of the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with his wife, Marie Curie, for their work on radioactivity. With their win, the Curies became the first married couple to win a Nobel Prize, launching the Curie family legacy of five Nobel Prizes.

zh.t: 玛丽·居里和皮埃尔·居里宣布分离出镭
zh.s: 皮埃尔·居里（1859年5月15日—1906年4月19日）是法国物理学家和化学家，也是晶体学与磁学领域的先驱。他与妻子玛丽·居里因放射性研究共同获得1903年诺贝尔物理学奖的一半奖金。获奖后，居里夫妇成为首对获得诺贝尔奖的夫妻，也开启了居里家族共获五项诺贝尔奖的传承。

en.s: The Battle for Lake Tanganyika was a series of naval engagements that took place between elements of the Royal Navy, Force Publique and the Kaiserliche Marine between December 1915 and July 1916, during the First World War. The intention was to secure control of the strategically important Lake Tanganyika, which had been dominated by German naval units since the beginning of the war. The British forces – consisting of two motor boats named HMS Mimi and Toutou – were under the command of the eccentric Lieutenant-Commander Geoffrey Spicer-Simson. The boats were transported to South Africa and from there by railway, by river, and by being dragged through the African jungle, to the lake. In two short engagements, the small motor boats attacked and defeated two of their German opponents. In the first action, on 26 December 1915 Kingani was damaged and captured, becoming HMS Fifi.

zh.s: 坦噶尼喀湖战役是第一次世界大战期间的一系列海战，1915年12月至1916年7月间，英国皇家海军、刚果自由邦军队和德意志帝国海军的部队在此交战。交战各方意在控制具有战略意义的坦噶尼喀湖；自战争开始以来，德国海军部队一直控制着该湖。英国方面的两艘摩托艇HMS Mimi和HMS Toutou由古怪的海军中校杰弗里·斯派塞-辛普森指挥。两艇先运到南非，再经铁路和河流运输，最后被拖过非洲丛林抵达湖区。两次短暂交战中，摩托艇击败了两艘德国舰艇。第一次交战发生于1915年12月26日，Kingani号受损后被俘，并改名为HMS Fifi。

en.s: The Battle of the Kerch Peninsula, which commenced with the Soviet Kerch-Feodosia Landing Operation (Russian: Керченско-Феодосийская десантная операция, romanized: Kerchensko-Feodosiyskaya desantnaya operatsiya) and ended with the German Operation Bustard Hunt (German: Unternehmen Trappenjagd), was a World War II battle between Erich von Manstein's German and Romanian 11th Army and the Soviet Crimean Front forces in the Kerch Peninsula, in the eastern part of the Crimean Peninsula. It began on 26 December 1941, with an amphibious landing operation by two Soviet armies intended to break the Siege of Sevastopol.

zh.s: 刻赤半岛战役始于苏联刻赤—费奥多西亚登陆行动，最终以德国“鸨猎行动”结束，是第二次世界大战期间德国、罗马尼亚第11集团军与苏联克里米亚方面军在克里米亚半岛东部刻赤半岛进行的一场战役。1941年12月26日，两支苏军发动两栖登陆，意图打破塞瓦斯托波尔之围，战役由此开始。

en.t: Winston Churchill's address to the United States Congress (1941)
en.s: Winston Churchill's first address to the 77th United States Congress was a 30-minute World War II-era radio-broadcast speech made in the chamber of the United States Senate on December 26, 1941. The prime minister of the United Kingdom addressed a joint meeting of the bicameral legislature of the United States about the state of the UK–U.S. alliance and their prospects for defeating the Axis powers.

zh.t: 丘吉尔在美国国会演讲（1941年）

en.s: The Battle of the North Cape was a Second World War naval battle on 26 December 1943, part of the Arctic campaign. The German battleship Scharnhorst sailed to implement Operation Ostfront, an attack on Arctic convoys carrying supplies from the western Allies to the Soviet Union. Scharnhorst was brought to battle and sunk by the battleship HMS Duke of York and its cruisers and destroyers.

en.s: The Battle of Cape Gloucester was fought in the Pacific theater of World War II between Japanese and Allied forces on the island of New Britain, Territory of New Guinea, between 26 December 1943 and 16 January 1944. Codenamed Operation Backhander, the US landing formed part of the wider Operation Cartwheel, the main Allied strategy in the South West Pacific Area and Pacific Ocean Areas during 1943–1944.

zh.s: 1943年12月26日至1944年1月16日，日军与盟军在新几内亚领地的新不列颠岛交战，这是第二次世界大战太平洋战场上的格洛斯特角战役。美军登陆代号为“反手”行动，是盟军1943—1944年西南太平洋及太平洋地区主要战略“车轮”行动的一部分。

en.s: The Landing on Long Island in the Territory of New Guinea was part of the Huon Peninsula campaign, a series of operations that made up Operation Cartwheel, General Douglas MacArthur's campaign to encircle the major Japanese base at Rabaul. Located at the northern end of the Vitiaz Strait, Long Island was an important staging point for Japanese barges moving between Rabaul and Wewak until 26 December 1943, when a force of 220 Australian and American soldiers landed on the island.

zh.t: 新几内亚领地长岛登陆战
zh.s: 新几内亚领地的长岛登陆行动是休恩半岛战役的一部分；该战役属于道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军包围日军拉包尔主要基地的“卡特威尔行动”系列作战。长岛位于维蒂亚兹海峡北端，一直是日军驳船往返拉包尔与韦瓦克的重要中转点，直至1943年12月26日，220名澳大利亚和美国士兵在岛上登陆。

en.s: The siege of Bastogne (French pronunciation: [bas.tɔɲ] ) was an engagement in December 1944 between American and German forces at the Belgian town of Bastogne, as part of the larger Battle of the Bulge. The goal of the German offensive was the harbor at Antwerp. In order to reach it before the Allies could regroup and bring their superior air power to bear, German mechanized forces had to seize the roadways through eastern Belgium.

en.t: The Communist Party of the Philippines is established by Jose Maria Sison, breaking away from the Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas-1930
en.s: The Communist Party of the Philippines (CPP; Filipino: Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas) is a far-left, Marxist–Leninist–Maoist revolutionary organization and communist party in the Philippines, formed by Jose Maria Sison on 26 December 1968 following a split in the original Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas. en.s: The 1976 New South Wales Open, also known by its sponsored name Marlboro New South Wales Open, was a combined men's and women's tennis tournament played on outdoor grass courts at the White City Stadium in Sydney, Australia. The men's was part of the 1977 Colgate-Palmolive Grand Prix circuit. It was the 84th edition of the event and was held from 26 December 1976 through 1 January 1977. The singles titles were won by Kerry Reid and 33-year-old Tony Roche. It was Roche's fourth singles title after 1967, 1969 and 1974. Roche won AUS$13,500 first-prize money while Reid's title was rewarded with AUS$5,000 prize money.

en.s: The Ukrainian presidential election, 2004 was held on October 31, November 21 and December 26, 2004. The election was the fourth presidential election to take place in Ukraine following independence from the Soviet Union. The last stages of the election were contested between the opposition leader Viktor Yushchenko and the incumbent Prime Minister Viktor Yanukovych from the Party of Regions. The election was held in a highly charged political atmosphere, with allegations of media bias, voter intimidation and a poisoning of candidate Yushchenko with dioxin. According to Ukraine's electoral law, a two-round system is used to elect the President in which a candidate must win a majority (50% or more) of all ballots cast.

zh.s: 乌克兰2004年总统选举于10月31日、11月21日和12月26日分阶段举行。最后阶段由反对派领袖维克托·尤先科与时任总理、地区党候选人维克托·亚努科维奇角逐。选举期间政治气氛紧张，并出现媒体偏向、恐吓选民和尤先科二噁英中毒等指控。

en.s: On 26 December 2004, at 07:58:53 local time (UTC+7), a Mw 9.2–9.3 earthquake struck with its epicenter off the west coast of Aceh, in northern Sumatra, Indonesia. The undersea megathrust earthquake, known in the scientific community as the Sumatra–Andaman earthquake, was caused by a rupture along the fault boundary between the Burma plate and the Indian plate, and reached a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX in some areas.

zh.s: 2004年12月26日当地时间7时58分53秒（UTC+7），印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛北部亚齐省西岸附近发生震级9.2至9.3级的海底巨型逆冲断层地震。地震由缅甸板块与印度板块边界破裂引发，部分地区麦加利烈度达到IX级。

en.s: The Battle of Baidoa began on 20 December 2006 when the Somali transitional federal government forces (TFG) allied with Ethiopian forces stationed there attacked advancing Islamic Courts Union (ICU) forces along with 500 alleged Eritrean troops and mujahideen arrayed against them. The battle began with most reports depicting the government forces defecting and its position on the verge of collapse.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2006年12月20日，索马里过渡联邦政府军与驻扎当地的埃塞俄比亚部队联手，袭击伊斯兰法院联盟及其盟友，战斗持续至12月26日。当天，伊斯兰法院联盟部队据报在激战数日后撤离布尔哈卡巴和迪因苏尔，遗下重型武器和其他装备。

en.s: The 2006 Hengchun earthquakes occurred on December 26 at 20:26 and 20:34 local time off the southwest coast of Taiwan in the Luzon Strait, which connects the South China Sea with the Philippine Sea. The International Seismological Centre measured the shocks at 7.0 and 6.9 on the moment magnitude scale. The earthquakes not only caused casualties and building damage, but several submarine communications cables were cut, disrupting telecommunication services in various parts of Asia.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2006年恒春地震于12月26日当地时间20时26分和20时34分发生在台湾西南海岸外的吕宋海峡。吕宋海峡连接南海与菲律宾海。国际地震中心测得两次地震的矩震级分别为7.0和6.9。地震造成人员伤亡和建筑损坏，多条海底通信电缆也被切断，亚洲多个地区的电信服务因此中断。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的当地日期。

en.s: Operation Sond Chara (Red Dagger in Pashto) was a campaign in the War in Afghanistan with aims and objectives centred on four Taliban strongholds near the town of Nad-e-Ali in Helmand Province, Afghanistan. The operation was named after the commando patch worn by members of 3 Commando Brigade Royal Marines.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “红匕首行动”（普什图语：Sond Chara）是阿富汗战争期间的一场军事行动，目标是赫尔曼德省纳德阿里镇附近的四处塔利班据点。行动名称取自英国皇家海军陆战队第3突击旅成员佩戴的突击队徽章。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2011 Guinea-Bissau coup attempt was a failed coup d'état by a group of renegade soldiers. Taking place on the morning of December 26, 2011, fighting broke out between two factions in the armed forces with sounds of automatic weapons and rocket fire erupting in the Santa Luzia army base which alarmed residents in the country's capital of Bissau.

zh.s: 2011年12月26日上午，几内亚比绍军中两个派系在圣卢西亚军营爆发枪战，现场传出自动武器和火箭弹的声音，惊动首都比绍的居民。这次政变企图最终失败。

en.t: Beijing–Shijiazhuang high-speed railway () is a 281-kilometre high-speed rail line operated by China Railway High-speed between Beijing and Shijiazhuang (the provincial capital of Hebei) that opened on 26 December 2012 after 4 years of construction
en.s: Beijing–Shijiazhuang high-speed railway (simplified Chinese: 京石客运专线; traditional Chinese: 京石客運專線; pinyin: Jīng-Shí Kèyùn Zhuān Xiàn) is a 281-kilometre high-speed rail line operated by China Railway High-speed between Beijing and Shijiazhuang (the provincial capital of Hebei) that opened on 26 December 2012 after 4 years of construction. The total investment is 43.87 billion yuan. The design speed is 350 km/h (220 mph), and the opening cut travel times between Beijing and Shijiazhuang from 2 hours to about 1 hour.

zh.s: 京石客运专线全长281公里，连接北京与河北省会石家庄。线路于2012年12月26日开通，建设历时4年，总投资438.7亿元，设计时速350公里；开通后，两地列车行程从约2小时缩短至约1小时。

en.s: On 26 December 2013, an Irkut-Avia Antonov An-12 operating a domestic cargo flight in Russia from Yeltsovka Airport, Novosibirsk, crashed on approach to its destination, Irkutsk Northwest Airport, Irkutsk. All nine people on board, six crew members and three passengers, were killed in the accident. The accident has been found to have been caused mainly by pilot error, even though later inquiries suggested that a failure of the engine number two might have been the main factor that led to the crash.

zh.t: 2013年伊尔库特航空安-12运输机坠毁
zh.s: 2013年12月26日，伊尔库特航空一架安-12货机从俄罗斯新西伯利亚叶利佐夫卡机场飞往伊尔库茨克，在接近伊尔库茨克西北机场时坠毁。机上6名机组人员和3名乘客共9人全部遇难。调查主要认定事故由飞行员操作失误造成，但后续调查认为，2号发动机故障可能是导致坠机的主要因素。

en.t: Battle of Tell Hamis and Tell Brak (2013–2014)
en.s: The Battle of Tell Hamis and Tell Brak was fought between the end of December 2013 and the start of January 2014 over control of the town of Tell Hamis and the village of Tell Brak in the al-Hasakah Governorate of northeast Syria during the Syrian Civil War.

en.s: Indian Army operations in Jammu and Kashmir, India, it includes security operations such as Operation Rakshak, which began in 1990, Operation Sarp Vinash in 2003 and Operation Randori Behak in 2020. Other operations include humanitarian missions such as Operation Megh Rahat and operations with a social aim such as Operation Goodwill and Operation Calm Down.

zh.s: 印度陆军在查谟和克什米尔开展的行动包括安全行动，如1990年开始的“守护者行动”、2003年的“蛇形行动”和2020年的“兰多里贝赫克行动”；也包括“梅格·拉哈特行动”等人道任务，以及“善意行动”和“冷静行动”等社会服务行动。

en.s: On the night of December 26, 2015, a violent EF4 tornado struck the Dallas suburbs of Sunnyvale, Garland, and Rowlett, located in Texas. It caused $20–26 million (2015 USD) in damages, killed 10 people, making it the deadliest tornado in the United States in 2015, and injured 468 others. This was the third tornado to be rated an EF4 in the United States that year and the fourth such tornado worldwide.

zh.s: 2015年12月26日晚，一场EF4级强龙卷风袭击得克萨斯州达拉斯郊区的桑尼维尔、加兰和罗莱特，造成2,000万至2,600万美元（2015年币值）的损失，10人死亡、468人受伤。这是当年美国第三场EF4级龙卷风，也是全球第四场。

en.s: The 2015 Thai FA Cup final was the final match of the 2015 Thai FA Cup, the 22nd season of a Thailand's football tournament organised by Football Association of Thailand. It was played at the Supachalasai Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand on 26 December 2015, between SCG Muangthong United a big team from the metropolitan region and Buriram United a big team from the northeastern region of Thailand.

zh.s: 2015年泰国足协杯决赛是泰国足球协会主办的2015年泰国足协杯决赛，也是该项赛事第22个赛季的最后一场比赛。比赛于2015年12月26日在泰国曼谷的苏帕查拉赛体育场举行，对阵双方为来自首都地区的强队蒙通联和来自泰国东北部的强队武里南联。

en.t: The line was opened to traffic on 26 December 2016
en.s: Changsha–Zhuzhou–Xiangtan intercity railway or Changzhutan intercity railway (Chinese: 长株潭城际铁路; pinyin: Cháng–Zhū–Tán chéngjì tiělù), is a higher-speed regional railway in Hunan, China. It connects the provincial capital Changsha with Zhuzhou and Xiangtan. The line was opened to traffic on 26 December 2016. A northwestern extension to Changsha West railway station opened on 26 December 2017.

zh.t: 长株潭城际铁路开通运营
zh.s: 长株潭城际铁路连接湖南省会长沙与株洲、湘潭，于2016年12月26日开通运营。通往长沙西站的西北延长线则于2017年12月26日开通。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the Likud party on 26 December 2019. Incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu defeated Gideon Sa'ar by a large majority.

en.s: On December 26, 2021, a mass shooting took place at a Texaco convenience store in Garland, Texas, United States. Three teenage boys were killed and another was seriously injured before the alleged perpetrator, 14-year-old Abel Acosta, fled the scene. As of 2026, Abel is wanted for the shooting and believed to be hiding in Mexico.

zh.s: 2021年12月26日，美国得克萨斯州加兰一家德士古便利店发生枪击案，3名十几岁的男孩死亡，另有1人重伤。14岁的嫌疑人阿贝尔·阿科斯塔逃离现场；截至2026年，他仍在逃，据信藏身墨西哥。

en.s: The Battle of Shuja'iyya was a military engagement between Israel and Hamas-led Palestinian forces in December 2023 during the Gaza war. During the Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip, Shuja'iyya was the last district in Gaza City that had not been subject to an Israeli ground invasion, and as a result many Palestinians who had not been able to evacuate south had sought refuge in the district.

en.s: The 2024 Albanian Supercup was the 31th edition of the Albanian Supercup, an annual Albanian football match. The teams were decided by taking the trophy winners of the previous season's Kategoria Superiore champions and the winners of the Albanian Cup. Since Egnatia won both competitions, they will play against the runner-up of the cup. The match was contested by Egnatia, champions of the 2023–24 Kategoria Superiore, and Kukësi, the 2023–24 Albanian Cup runner-up.

zh.s: 2024年阿尔巴尼亚超级杯是第31届阿尔巴尼亚超级杯，这项年度足球赛事由阿尔巴尼亚足球协会组织。参赛队伍由上赛季阿尔巴尼亚足球超级联赛冠军和阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军决定。由于埃格纳蒂亚包揽两项赛事冠军，因此将由该队对阵杯赛亚军。最终参赛双方为2023—24赛季超级联赛冠军埃格纳蒂亚和阿尔巴尼亚杯亚军库克斯。

en.t: Israel recognises Somaliland as an independent state, becoming the first country to do so
en.s: On 26 December 2025, the State of Israel became the first country and UN member state to officially recognise the Republic of Somaliland as a sovereign and independent state. Somaliland regards itself as the legal successor of the State of Somaliland, whose five-day independence in 1960 was also recognised by Israel and 34 other countries. The entirety of modern Somaliland's territory is claimed but not controlled by Somalia, which does not officially recognise Israel.

zh.t: 以色列承认索马里兰为独立国家
zh.s: 2025年12月26日，以色列成为首个正式承认索马里兰为主权独立国家的国家，也是首个承认索马里兰的联合国会员国。索马里兰方面认为自己是前英属索马里兰国的合法继承者。
